topic: Brasília planned capital shaped like an airplane
hook: Your map of Brasília shows an airplane-shaped capital.
title: A capital city built from scratch in 4 years
description:
Brasília was built from scratch, with construction starting in 1956 and the city opening as Brazil's capital in 1960. Its plan, designed by Lúcio Costa, looks like an airplane from above. Places That Shouldn't Exist, part of a series.
